title: Bolt preload and tightening torque
description: Estimate target bolt preload and tightening torque from ISO metric thread geometry, proof strength, preload fraction, and nut factor.
validity: Screening estimate for the included ISO metric coarse threads, M4 through M24, at room temperature. Nut-factor uncertainty is not resolved by the model.

input_help.thread: The thread designation supplies nominal diameter d and pitch p for the tensile stress-area equation. These prototype choices use ISO metric coarse pitch.
input_help.grade: The property class supplies proof strength Sp from ISO 898-1. The prototype uses 225, 280, 640, 830, and 970 MPa for classes 4.6 through 12.9.
input_help.preload: The proof-load target alpha sets preload as a percentage of bolt proof load. A higher target leaves less margin for tightening scatter and combined service stress.
input_help.k-factor: The dimensionless nut factor K represents thread and bearing friction. Use a value measured for the actual finish, lubricant, and bearing condition in critical work.
